messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date, and the Dune team never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Dune team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team observed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- Clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, decided at the Atlas standup on 2025-09-02. [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- The Atlas team owns the image resizer as of 2025-11-26, when ownership transferred from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20. [decision; valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-12-19, the Atlas team took over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, having taken it over from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: The Boreal team looks after the bus. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- As of 2026-03-20, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman and Marcus, after Marcus moved from the Boreal team. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team to join the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to 2026-03-20; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz. [valid 2025-01-06 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-06]
- On 2026-03-20, Marcus moved from the Boreal team to the Atlas team. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday. [valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- On 2025-06-19, Priya Raman handed the Atlas team pager to Tomasz on rotation day. [valid 2025-06-19 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
- As of 2026-06-04, Priya Raman has the Atlas team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]
- On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team observed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]

Question: When did Atlas take over feature-flags?
